name: EPIC 201895242
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 10.5 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201895242 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.450743 (16th-84th percentiles 10.109707-10.840095), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201895242 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.912392 (16th-84th percentiles 0.845544-1.002687), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201895242: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4917.87 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201895242 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3326.210938 (16th-84th percentiles 3253.164062-3399.492188), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.18 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,326 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.91 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,918 K at its surface.
